verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes how to create, invoke, and install skills/plugins (SKILL.md, /plugin install, marketplaces) but contains no documentation of a command or mechanism to list installed skills or cleanly uninstall/remove them (e.g., no '/skill list', '/plugin uninstall', or removal instructions). The only related setting, disableBundledSkills, only disables bundled skills rather than removing them or any custom ones cleanly.
